That's also just one point of the changes in the child tax credit in this bill. There's three other items that we're doing. One, we're eliminating what I refer to as the child penalty. It allows it where work requirement for your first child and your second child and your third child. That is a huge provision that will help a lot of working families. The other thing that we're doing is the top line $2,000. It's been $2,000 since 2017. And the issue is, is that, you know, when you're in divided government, where my counterparts on the Senate side are controlled by Democrats, we're controlled by Republicans, you have to find some common ground.
